Barry L Stratton and James D. Miller.   November  1991

Includes (but are not limited to:) (1) Alaska Board of Fisheries and Fishery Management council reports (2) Season summaries (3) White papers (4) management plans (5) annual test fish results (6) legislative reports (7) forecast (8) area management reports (9) annual shellfish surveys (10) some annual U.S./Canada;  and since the 1993, the following studies have been published in this series:  (11) Salmon abundance, catch and escapements studies (12) annual smolt reports (13) tagging studies and (14) special short-term or interim reports on equipment or methodologies, stock identification, management, life history, etc..

This series is primarily informational, serving to: (1) promote intradepartmental exchange of information and (2) meet ad hoc reporting functions of the department to other agencies, governmental and regulatory bodies, the fishing industry and the public.
